_comment: Per-app override deep-merged onto josh-approved-factory/templates/privacy/privacy-declarations.json by push-privacy-forms.mjs. packing-list turns OFF three accessibility claims the studio default asserts, because they are not true here yet — the reasons and evidence are the 'Not claimed' block in STORE_LISTING.md § Accessibility Nutrition Labels (verified 2026-07-20, defects open in defects/packing-list.jsonl). Claiming them on the App Store product page would be a false accessibility claim, which is worse than claiming nothing. Flip each back to true in the SAME change that fixes and re-verifies it.

accessibility._comment: supportsVoiceControl: several accessibilityLabels are descriptive sentences that diverge from the visible text, so speaking a control's visible name does not reliably match it (defect packing-list-20260720-1, open). supportsLargerText: text scales, but ~37 fixed numeric lineHeights do not, so lines clip at AX5 (defect packing-list-20260720-2, open). supportsSufficientContrast: NEARLY CLEAR — the body-text failure was fixed 2026-07-21 (fb0ed2c) and defect packing-list-20260720-3 is closed; what remains is the fgSubtle token itself at 2.68:1 light / 3.72:1 dark, still used for three placeholderTextColor call sites and several interactive icons. Swap those to fgMuted and this one flips back to true.
